qe: The Bardoli Satyagraha, a landmark peasant movement in modern Indian history, erupted in January 1926. What was the immediate cause that sparked this historic agitation?
qh: आधुनिक भारतीय इतिहास में एक ऐतिहासिक किसान आंदोलन, बारडोली सत्याग्रह, जनवरी 1926 में भड़क उठा था। इस ऐतिहासिक आंदोलन को शुरू करने वाला तात्कालिक कारण क्या था?
oe: The authorities decided to increase the land revenue by 30 per cent
The total legal abolition of the system of separate communal electorates
The forced cultivation of indigo on 3/20th part of the peasant lands
The mandatory registration of all local workers under the Rowlatt Act guidelines
oh: अधिकारियों ने भू-राजस्व में 30 प्रतिशत की वृद्धि करने का निर्णय लिया
पृथक सांप्रदायिक निर्वाचक मंडल की प्रणाली का पूर्ण कानूनी उन्मूलन
किसानों की भूमि के 3/20वें हिस्से पर नील की जबरन खेती
रौलट एक्ट के दिशानिर्देशों के तहत सभी स्थानीय श्रमिकों का अनिवार्य पंजीकरण
e:
Bardoli Satyagraha (1926-1928) Gujarat ke Surat district ke Bardoli taluqa mein British colonial government ke unjust aur arbitrary tax hike ke khilaf ek prominent peasant movement tha.

• Option 1 is Correct because January 1926 mein colonial authorities ne Bardoli taluka mein land revenue assessment ko bina kisi sound agricultural evaluation ke flat 30 per cent badhane ka faisla kiya tha, jo is mass agitation ka immediate spark bana.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because separate communal electorates ka issue constitutional politics se related tha, 3/20th indigo cultivation (Tinkathia system) Champaran Satyagraha (1917) ka primary cause tha, aur Rowlatt Act 1919 ka civil liberties suppression measure tha.

Examiner trap: Students often confuse the percentage increase; initially government proposed a 30% hike, which after public pressure was lowered to 22%, and finally after Maxwell-Broomfield inquiry, settled at only 6.03%.

qe: In February 1926, which prominent leader was formally called upon by the local Congress ranks to lead the Bardoli peasant struggle against the revised revenue assessment?
qh: फरवरी 1926 में, संशोधित राजस्व आकलन के खिलाफ बारडोली किसान संघर्ष का नेतृत्व करने के लिए स्थानीय कांग्रेस रैंकों द्वारा किस प्रमुख नेता को औपचारिक रूप से बुलाया गया था?
e:
Bardoli Satyagraha ke initial phase mein local leaders jaise Mehta brothers (Kalyanji aur Kunverji) aur Dayalji Desai ne local peasantry ko unite kiya tha.

• Option 1 is Correct because local leadership aur Bardoli Inquiry Committee ke assessment ke baad, February 1926 mein Vallabhbhai Patel ko formally invite kiya gaya movement ki kaman sambhalne ke liye, jinhone tax refusal ki shart par leadership accept ki.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because Jawaharlal Nehru national platform par active the, Swami Sahjanand Saraswati Bihar Kisan Sabha ke founder the, aur Baba Ramchandra Awadh (UP) ke kisan movement se jude the.

Examiner trap: Candidates confuse local organizers (Mehta brothers) with the supreme leader of the movement (Vallabhbhai Patel).

qe: During the course of the Bardoli Satyagraha, the title of 'Sardar' was famously bestowed upon Vallabhbhai Patel. Which specific section of the mobilization group gave him this honor?
qh: बारडोली सत्याग्रह के दौरान, वल्लभभाई पटेल को प्रसिद्ध रूप से 'सरदार' की उपाधि दी गई थी। लामबंदी समूह के किस विशिष्ट वर्ग ने उन्हें यह सम्मान दिया था?
oe: The members of the Bombay Legislative Council
The youth volunteers of the chhavanis
The centralized high command of the All India Kisan Sabha
oh: अखिल भारतीय किसान सभा की केंद्रीय उच्च कमान
e:
Bardoli Satyagraha mein women mobilization ek unprecedented feature tha, jahan Mithuben Petit, Maniben Patel aur Sharda Mehta jaisi mahilao ne rural women ko actively lead kiya.

• Option 1 is Correct because Vallabhbhai Patel ki organizational capability, fearless leadership aur peasants ke welfare ke prati dedication ko dekhte hue Bardoli ki women ne unhe prem aur samman se 'Sardar' (Chief/Leader) ki upadhi di, jise Mahatma Gandhi ne nationally endorse kiya.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because Legislative Council ke members ne sympathy mein resign kiya tha, youth volunteers chhavani chala rahe the, aur AIKS ka formation 1936 mein hua tha.

Examiner trap: UPSC/State PSCs mein aksar pucha jata hai ki title kisne diya—women of Bardoli directly gave the title, while Gandhi popularised it across India.

qe: Under the leadership of Sardar Patel, the Bardoli peasants resolved to refuse tax payments until the colonial government met which explicit baseline condition?
qh: सरदार पटेल के नेतृत्व में, बारडोली के किसानों ने करों का भुगतान करने से इनकार करने का संकल्प लिया, जब तक कि औपनिवेशिक सरकार ने किस स्पष्ट बुनियादी शर्त को पूरा नहीं किया?
oe: Until the Government appointed an independent tribunal or accepted the current amount as full payment
The immediate transfer of the provincial financial portfolio to the All India Kisan Congress
The total legal abolition of the landholder tenancy rights across the entire Bombay presidency
The structural integration of the local district board budgets with the central exchequer
oh: जब तक कि सरकार एक स्वतंत्र न्यायाधिकरण नियुक्त न करे या वर्तमान राशि को पूर्ण भुगतान के रूप में स्वीकार न करे
प्रांतीय वित्तीय विभाग का तत्काल अखिल भारतीय किसान कांग्रेस को हस्तांतरण
संपूर्ण बॉम्बे प्रेसीडेंसी में भूस्वामी किरायेदारी अधिकारों का पूर्ण कानूनी उन्मूलन
केंद्रीय राजकोष के साथ स्थानीय जिला बोर्ड के बजट का संरचनात्मक एकीकरण
e:
Bardoli Satyagraha pure non-violent civil disobedience principles par based revenue refusal agitation tha.

• Option 1 is Correct because Sardar Patel ki presence mein peasants ne firm pledge li ki wo revised tax tab tak pay nahi karenge jab tak colonial government ek independent judicial tribunal appoint na kare assessment investigate karne ke liye, ya fir older unrevised tax ko complete payment na maan le.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because movement ka objective pure agrarian-legal relief tha, na ki complete tenancy abolition ya provincial finance portfolio ka transfer.

Examiner trap: Agitation total tax exemption ke liye nahi balki arbitrary 30% hike ke khilaf unbiased investigation aur purane rate ko continue karne ke liye tha.

qe: To systematically organize, sustain, and coordinate the operations of the peasant movement across the Bardoli taluqa, how many 'chhavanis' (workers’ camps) were set up by Sardar Patel?
qh: बारडोली तालुका में किसान आंदोलन के कार्यों को व्यवस्थित रूप से आयोजित करने, बनाए रखने और समन्वय करने के लिए, सरदार पटेल द्वारा कितने 'छावनियों' (workers’ camps) की स्थापना की गई थी?
e:
Sardar Patel ek extraordinary organizer the jinhone movement ko decentralized yet highly disciplined unit banaya tha.

• Option 1 is Correct because poore Bardoli taluqa ko administrative convenience aur smooth communication ke liye 13 zones mein divide kiya gaya tha aur har zone mein ek 'Chhavani' (workers' camp) establish ki gayi thi, jise dedicated volunteers manage karte the.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because 450 branches, 15 camps ya 52 bases incorrect factual distractors hain.

Examiner trap: Numbers like 13 chhavanis are specific factual markers frequently tested in State PSCs to check micro-level precision.

qe: Which specific periodical publication was brought out by the organizers of the Bardoli Satyagraha to regularly mobilize public opinion and counter government propaganda?
qh: जनमत को नियमित रूप से लामबंद करने और सरकारी प्रचार का मुकाबला करने के लिए बारडोली सत्याग्रह के आयोजकों द्वारा कौन सा विशिष्ट आवधिक प्रकाशन निकाला गया था?
e:
Satyagraha ke communication mechanism ko strong rakhne aur colonial misinformation ko counter karne ke liye local press and print media ka extensive use kiya gaya.

• Option 1 is Correct because Sardar Patel aur unke associates ne 'Bardoli Satyagraha Patrika' publish kiya, jo rozana villages mein distribute hoti thi aur satyagrahis ko Patel ke speeches, instructions aur movement ke updates provide karti thi.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because Harijan weekly Mahatma Gandhi dwara 1933 mein start kiya gaya tha, Al Hilal Maulana Abul Kalam Azad ka paper tha, aur Comrade Maulana Mohammad Ali dwara nikala jata tha.

Examiner trap: Avoid confusing national weeklies (Harijan/Young India) with taluqa-specific struggle bulletins like Bardoli Satyagraha Patrika.

qe: What unique internal administrative mechanism was introduced by Sardar Patel during the Bardoli struggle to monitor tenant solidarity and ensure total compliance with the movement’s resolutions?
qh: किरायेदारों की एकजुटता की निगरानी करने और आंदोलन के प्रस्तावों का पूर्ण अनुपालन सुनिश्चित करने के लिए बारडोली संघर्ष के दौरान सरदार पटेल द्वारा कौन सा अनूठा आंतरिक प्रशासनिक तंत्र शुरू किया गया था?
oe: An intelligence wing was set up to check tenant compliance
A formal three-judge panel was appointed to legally try non-compliers
A secondary indirect electoral college filtered through village panchayats
A specialized armed volunteer corps equipped with modern firearms
oh: किरायेदार अनुपालन की जांच के लिए एक खुफिया शाखा की स्थापना की गई थी
अनुपालन न करने वालों पर कानूनी रूप से मुकदमा चलाने के लिए तीन न्यायाधीशों का एक औपचारिक पैनल नियुक्त किया गया था
ग्राम पंचायतों के माध्यम से फ़िल्टर किया गया एक द्वितीयक अप्रत्यक्ष निर्वाचक मंडल
आधुनिक आग्नेयास्त्रों से लैस एक विशेष सशस्त्र स्वयंसेवक कोर
e:
Bardoli Satyagraha ki success is baat par tiki thi ki koi bhi peasant chupke se colonial authorities ko tax pay na kar sake.

• Option 1 is Correct because movement ki internal discipline maintain karne aur government spies ya weak-willed defaulters ko identify karne ke liye ek organized grassroot intelligence wing set up ki gayi thi jo daily reporting karti thi.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because movement completely non-violent aur extra-judicial moral pressure par based tha, isliye arms ya formal courts ka concept applicable nahi tha.

Examiner trap: Students assume non-violent movements had no vigilance structures; Patel’s leadership heavily relied on systematic intelligence and community oversight.

qe: Under the disciplinary codes of the Bardoli movement, what primary social penalty was enforced against those individuals who opposed the resolutions and attempted to pay taxes to the government?
qh: बारडोली आंदोलन के अनुशासनात्मक संहिताओं के तहत, उन व्यक्तियों के खिलाफ कौन सा प्राथमिक सामाजिक दंड लागू किया गया था जिन्होंने प्रस्तावों का विरोध किया और सरकार को करों का भुगतान करने का प्रयास किया?
oe: Summary eviction from all ancestral land holdings
A flat financial penalty collected by the Kisan Sabha
Imprisonment inside secret underground matching cells
oh: सभी पैतृक भूमि जोतों से संक्षिप्त बेदखली
किसान सभा द्वारा एकत्र किया गया एक समान वित्तीय जुर्माना
गुप्त भूमिगत मिलान कक्षों के अंदर कारावास
e:
Gandhian Satyagraha methods mein physical violence strictly prohibited thi, isliye non-violent social enforcement tools use kiye jaate the.

• Option 1 is Correct because tax pay karne wale individuals aur government collaborators ke khilaf rigid 'Social Boycott' (samajik bahishkar) enforce kiya jata tha, jisme unhe community services, barbers, water sources aur social interaction se cut off kar diya jata tha.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because land eviction government karti thi na ki satyagrahis, aur illegal confinement ya violent punishment satyagraha code of conduct ke strictly against tha.

Examiner trap: Social boycott was rigorous but non-violent; it targeted social cooperation rather than physical intimidation.

qe: Which two prominent political figures resigned their legislative seats from the Bombay Legislative Council in open solidarity and support for the Bardoli peasant struggle?
qh: बारडोली किसान संघर्ष के खुले समर्थन और एकजुटता में किन दो प्रमुख राजनीतिक हस्तियों ने बॉम्बे विधान परिषद से अपनी विधायी सीटों से इस्तीफा दे दिया था?
oe: Madan Mohan Malaviya and Hasan Imam
Tej Bahadur Sapru and C.Y. Chintamani
Bhulabhai Desai and Liaquat Ali Khan
oh: मदन मोहन मालवीय और हसन इमाम
तेज बहादुर सप्रू और सी.वाई. चिंतामणि
भूलाभाई देसाई और लियाकत अली खान
e:
Bardoli movement ne constitutionalists aur moderate leaders ko bhi British policy ke khilaf khade hone par majboor kar diya tha.

• Option 1 is Correct because K.M. Munshi aur Lalji Naranji ne British government ki coercive action aur land confiscation policy ke protest mein Bombay Legislative Council se resign kar diya tha aur struggle ko constitutional weight diya.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because Malaviya Central Legislative Assembly mein active the, Sapru and Chintamani UP liberal politics se the, aur Bhulabhai Desai ne legal advice di thi par is council resignation se directly linked nahi the.

Examiner trap: K.M. Munshi was a constitutionalist; his resignation signaled the mainstream legal class's complete loss of faith in Bombay administration's tax policy.

qe: By August 1928, massive tension had built up in the area, accompanied by prospects of a major labor agitation in Bombay. What strike was looming that pressured the government to retreat?
qh: अगस्त 1928 तक क्षेत्र में भारी तनाव पैदा हो गया था, साथ ही बॉम्बे में एक बड़े श्रमिक आंदोलन की संभावना भी बन गई थी। कौन सी हड़ताल होने वाली थी जिसने सरकार को पीछे हटने के लिए मजबूर किया?
oe: A strike across all indigenous cotton textile mills
A general strike of the postal and telegraph courier ratings
oh: सभी स्वदेशी सूती कपड़ा मिलों में हड़ताल
डाक और टेलीग्राफ कूरियर रेटिंग्स की एक आम हड़ताल
e:
1928 tak Bardoli Satyagraha national crisis ban chuka tha aur working-class urban solidarity ne British administration ko defensive position par la diya tha.

• Option 1 is Correct because Bombay mein railway workers dwara planned massive railway strike ne British administration ke supply lines aur transport system ko paralyze karne ki threat di, jiske chalte colonial authorities negotiation table par aane ko majboor hue.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because textile mill strikes earlier thi par specific immediate breaking point August 1928 ka threatened Bombay railway transport strike tha.

Examiner trap: Peasant-worker alliance in 1928 was critical in creating administrative paralysis for the Bombay Presidency.

qe: Following independent tribunal evaluations at the conclusion of the Bardoli Satyagraha, what drastically reduced revenue hike percentage was recommended, down from the initial 30 percent?
qh: बारडोली सत्याग्रह के समापन पर स्वतंत्र न्यायाधिकरण (independent tribunal) के मूल्यांकन के बाद, शुरुआती 30 प्रतिशत से घटाकर कितने कम राजस्व वृद्धि प्रतिशत की सिफारिश की गई थी?
e:
Government of Bombay ne public pressure aur satyagraha ke success ke baad Broomfield and Maxwell Judicial-Revenue Committee appoint ki.

• Option 1 is Correct because Maxwell-Broomfield enquiry committee ne apni comprehensive audit report mein paya ki original assessment totally flawed tha, aur enhancement ko 30 per cent se drastically drop karke sirf **6.03 per cent** recommend kiya.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because 14%, 20% aur 10.5% speculative values hain jo official enquiry recommendation se match nahi karti.

Examiner trap: Remember the sequence: Proposed hike = 30%, Lowered by Govt in negotiation = 21.97% (~22%), Final Committee Recommendation = 6.03%.

qe: During the 1930s, the global macroeconomic environment heavily influenced the peasant awakening in India. What international industrial event triggered this phase of rural distress?
qh: 1930 के दशक के दौरान, वैश्विक समष्टि आर्थिक (macroeconomic) परिवेश ने भारत में किसान चेतना को भारी रूप से प्रभावित किया। किस अंतर्राष्ट्रीय औद्योगिक घटना ने ग्रामीण संकट के इस चरण को शुरू किया था?
oe: The Great Depression in industrialized countries
The sudden conclusion of the American Civil War price boom
The structural implementation of Napoleon's Continental System
The global trade collapse caused by the Treaty of Sevres parameters
oh: अमेरिकी गृहयुद्ध मूल्य उछाल का अचानक समापन
नेपोलियन की महाद्वीपीय प्रणाली का संरचनात्मक कार्यान्वयन
सेव्रेस की संधि के मापदंडों के कारण वैश्विक व्यापार पतन
e:
1929 ka Wall Street Crash aur uske baad aayi worldwide economic crisis ne colonial agrarian economies ko tabah kar diya tha.

• Option 1 is Correct because Great Depression (1929-1930s) ke chalte agricultural commodity prices 50% se zyada crash ho gayi, jabki land revenue aur debt interest rates fixed rahe, jisse small peasants bankrupt ho gaye aur country bhar mein radical kisan movements shuru hue.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because American Civil War 1860s mein Cotton boom crash se judi thi (Deccan Riots context), Napoleon 19th century shuruat mein tha, aur Treaty of Sevres 1920 mein Ottoman Empire se related thi.

Examiner trap: Chronology is key: 1860s = American Civil War (Deccan Riots), 1930s = Great Depression (Civil Disobedience & Kisan Sabha era).

qe: The historic All India Kisan Congress/Sabha (AIKS) was established to unify peasant struggles across the sub-continent. In which city and in what year was this premier body founded?
qh: उपमहाद्वीप भर में किसान संघर्षों को एकीकृत करने के लिए ऐतिहासिक अखिल भारतीय किसान कांग्रेस/सभा (AIKS) की स्थापना की गई थी। इस प्रमुख संस्था की स्थापना किस शहर में और किस वर्ष हुई थी?
e:
Peasant organizations ko national level par coordinate karne ke liye All India Kisan Congress (baad mein All India Kisan Sabha) form ki gayi thi.

• Option 1 is Correct because April 1936 mein Indian National Congress ke Lucknow session ke dauran All India Kisan Congress formally establish ki gayi thi jisme national level par agrarian rights ke liye charter pass kiya gaya.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because Nagpur 1920 mein Non-Cooperation movement approve hua tha, Patna (Bihta) 1929 mein Swami Sahjanand ne Bihar Provincial Kisan Sabha (BPKS) banayi thi, aur Calcutta 1906 mein INC session hua tha.

Examiner trap: Do not confuse Bihar Provincial Kisan Sabha (founded in 1929 at Sonepur/Patna) with All India Kisan Sabha (founded in 1936 at Lucknow).

qe: Who among the following prominent agrarian leaders was elected as the very first President of the All India Kisan Sabha at its inception in April 1936?
qh: निम्नलिखित प्रमुख कृषि नेताओं में से किसे अप्रैल 1936 में अपनी स्थापना के समय अखिल भारतीय किसान सभा के पहले अध्यक्ष के रूप में चुना गया था?
e:
All India Kisan Sabha (AIKS) ne Bharat ke prominent peasant champions ko ek platform par organize kiya.

• Option 1 is Correct because Swami Sahjanand Saraswati—jo Bihar ke legendary kisan leader aur thinker the—unhe unanimous choice ke roop mein All India Kisan Sabha ka pehla founding President elect kiya gaya tha.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because Prof. N.G. Ranga General Secretary chune gaye the, Indulal Yagnik periodical editor aur founding member the, aur Baba Ramchandra Awadh Kisan Sabha ke pioneer the.

Examiner trap: Swami Sahjanand Saraswati was the President, while N.G. Ranga was the General Secretary of AIKS at Lucknow in 1936.

qe: Who was appointed to the post of General Secretary of the All India Kisan Sabha during its historic first session at Lucknow in 1936?
qh: 1936 में लखनऊ में अपने ऐतिहासिक पहले सत्र के दौरान अखिल भारतीय किसान सभा के महासचिव (General Secretary) के पद पर किसे नियुक्त किया गया था?
e:
AIKS ke first executive council structure mein North aur South India ke major agrarian leaders ko core administrative posts di gayi thin.

• Option 1 is Correct because Andhra ke prominent peasant leader aur agricultural economist Prof. N.G. Ranga ko AIKS ka first General Secretary banaya gaya tha.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because Swami Sahjanand President the, Indulal Yagnik AIKS Patrika/journal se linked the, aur Gauri Shankar Mishra 1918 mein UP Kisan Sabha se jude the.

Examiner trap: Always remember the leadership pair of Lucknow 1936: President = Swami Sahjanand; General Secretary = N.G. Ranga.

qe: The newly established All India Kisan Sabha launched a critical periodic publication to propagate its manifesto and mobilize the agrarian masses. Under whose leadership was this periodical started?
qh: नव स्थापित अखिल भारतीय किसान सभा ने अपने घोषणापत्र का प्रचार करने और कृषि जनता को लामबंद करने के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण आवधिक प्रकाशन (periodic publication) शुरू किया। यह पत्रिका किसके नेतृत्व में शुरू की गई थी?
e:
Agrarian struggle aur Kisan Manifesto ko propagate karne ke liye AIKS ne periodic journals aur bulletins start kiye the.

• Option 1 is Correct because prominent freedom fighter aur Gujarat ke kisan leader Indulal Yagnik ne Kisan Sabha ke official periodical aur press operations ko organize aur manage kiya tha.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because N.G. Ranga organizational tours par focused the, Nehru party level communication handle karte the, aur Patel right-wing Congress leadership mein the jinke relations Kisan Sabha se critical the.

Examiner trap: Indulal Yagnik played a foundational role in shaping the literary and journalistic voice of the Kisan movement.

qe: In late 1936, both the All India Kisan Sabha and the Indian National Congress concurrently held their annual sessions at the same location, heavily influencing the subsequent Congress election manifesto. Where did these sessions take place?
qh: 1936 के उत्तरार्ध में, अखिल भारतीय किसान सभा और भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस दोनों ने एक ही स्थान पर अपने वार्षिक सत्र आयोजित किए, जिसने बाद के कांग्रेस चुनाव घोषणापत्र को भारी रूप से प्रभावित किया। ये सत्र कहाँ हुए थे?
e:
Congress ke rural roots ko expand karne ke liye 1936 ka annual session pehli baar ek rural area mein hold kiya gaya tha.

• Option 1 is Correct because Maharashtra ke **Faizpur** mein 1936 ke end mein Congress aur All India Kisan Sabha ke concurrent sessions hue, jahan Kisan Manifesto ne Congress ke 1937 agrarian election programme ko heavily shape kiya.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because Tripuri session 1939 mein hua (Subhas Bose presidential crisis), Haripura session 1938 mein hua tha, aur Nagpur session 1920 ka landmark tha.

Examiner trap: Faizpur (1936) was the first Congress session held in a rural village, presided over by Jawaharlal Nehru.

qe: On August 15, 1947, Jawaharlal Nehru was sworn in as the first Prime Minister of independent India. Exactly how many members assisted him within this historic first Council of Ministers?
qh: 15 अगस्त, 1947 को जवाहरलाल नेहरू ने स्वतंत्र भारत के पहले प्रधानमंत्री के रूप में शपथ ली थी। इस ऐतिहासिक पहले मंत्रिपरिषद के भीतर कुल कितने सदस्यों ने उनकी सहायता की थी?
e:
15 August 1947 ko transfer of power ke sath independent India ka pehla broad-based, multi-party executive cabinet form kiya gaya tha.

• Option 1 is Correct because Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru ke alawa cabinet mein 14 other prominent cabinet ministers shamil the (including Sardar Patel, Maulana Azad, Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, John Mathai, Shyama Prasad Mookherjee, etc.), jisse first Council of Ministers mein total 15 core members the.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because 8, 13 ya 3 members historical cabinet size se mismatch karte hain.

Examiner trap: Ensure clarity between the total strength of the Council (15 including PM) vs the number of other assisting cabinet ministers (14).

qe: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel occupied a paramount position in the first government of independent India. What specific portfolios did he manage until his death in December 1950?
qh: स्वतंत्र भारत की पहली सरकार में सरदार वल्लभभाई पटेल का सर्वोच्च स्थान था। दिसंबर 1950 में अपनी मृत्यु तक उन्होंने किन विशिष्ट विभागों (portfolios) का प्रबंधन किया था?
oe: Deputy Prime Minister; Minister of Home Affairs and States; Minister of Information and Broadcasting
Vice President of Executive Council and Minister of External Affairs and Commonwealth Relations exclusively
Minister of Relief and Rehabilitation combined with the Scientific Research portfolio
Minister of Industries and Supplies under a joint alliance with the Hindu Mahasabha
oh: उप प्रधानमंत्री; गृह और राज्य मामलों के मंत्री; सूचना और प्रसारण मंत्री
विशेष रूप से कार्यकारी परिषद के उपाध्यक्ष और विदेश तथा राष्ट्रमंडल संबंध मंत्री
वैज्ञानिक अनुसंधान विभाग के साथ संयुक्त राहत और पुनर्वास मंत्री
हिंदू महासभा के साथ संयुक्त गठबंधन के तहत उद्योग और आपूर्ति मंत्री
e:
Independent India ke administrative structure aur princely integration mein Sardar Patel ka portfolio decisive tha.

• Option 1 is Correct because Sardar Patel ne free India ke first Deputy Prime Minister ke roop mein service di aur unke paas **Home Affairs, Ministry of States (Princely States Integration), aur Information & Broadcasting** ke key portfolios the.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because External Affairs Jawaharlal Nehru ke paas tha, Relief & Rehabilitation K.C. Neogy ke paas tha, aur Industries & Supplies Dr. Shyama Prasad Mookherjee ke paas tha.

Examiner trap: Do not confuse Ministry of States (V.P. Menon as Secretary, Patel as Minister) with provincial state governments.

qe: Who was assigned the vital responsibility of managing the Ministry of Education within the first Council of Ministers of independent India in August 1947?
qh: अगस्त 1947 में स्वतंत्र भारत के पहले मंत्रिपरिषद के भीतर शिक्षा मंत्रालय (Ministry of Education) के प्रबंधन की महत्वपूर्ण जिम्मेदारी किसे सौंपी गई थी?
e:
Maulana Abul Kalam Azad national movement ke premier scholar, journalist aur Congress ke longest-serving wartime president the.

• Option 1 is Correct because 15 August 1947 ko Maulana Azad ko independent India ka pehla Education Minister banaya gaya; unke tenure mein UGC, IITs, aur Sahitya/Sangeet Natak Akademis establish hui.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because John Mathai Railways & Transport dekhte the, Shanmukham Chetty Finance Minister the, aur B.R. Ambedkar Law Minister the.

Examiner trap: National Education Day is celebrated on 11th November in honor of Maulana Abul Kalam Azad's birth anniversary.

qe: Which prominent leader managed the critical portfolio of the Ministry of Defence in the immediate post-independence Council of Ministers?
qh: स्वतंत्रता के तुरंत बाद बने मंत्रिपरिषद में रक्षा मंत्रालय (Ministry of Defence) के महत्वपूर्ण विभाग का प्रबंधन किस प्रमुख नेता ने किया था?
e:
Interim Government (1946) aur first independent cabinet (1947) dono mein defense architecture ki continuity maintain ki gayi thi.

• Option 1 is Correct because Sardar Baldev Singh—jo Panthic Akali leader the—unhe 1947 mein independent India ka first Defence Minister appoint kiya gaya tha jinhone 1947-48 Indo-Pak conflict ke dauran forces ko lead kiya.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because Jairamdas Daulatram Food & Agriculture minister the, C.H. Bhabha Commerce dekhte the, aur N.V. Gadgil Works, Mines and Power ke minister the.

Examiner trap: Baldev Singh held the Defence portfolio continuously across both the 1946 Interim Government and the 1947 Independent Cabinet.

qe: Who served as the first Minister of Finance of independent India, presenting the initial budgetary frameworks of the newly liberated nation?
qh: स्वतंत्र भारत के पहले वित्त मंत्री (Minister of Finance) के रूप में किसने कार्य किया, जिन्होंने नव स्वतंत्र राष्ट्र के प्रारंभिक बजटीय ढांचे को प्रस्तुत किया था?
e:
Partition aur post-war inflation ke dauran free India ka pehla budget draft karna ek monumental task tha.

• Option 1 is Correct because R.K. Shanmukham Chetty independent India ke pehle Finance Minister bane aur unhone 26 November 1947 ko independent India ka first union budget present kiya.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because John Mathai ne Shanmukham Chetty ke resignation ke baad Finance portfolio sambhala tha (1948 mein), K.C. Neogy First Finance Commission ke Chairman the, aur Mohanlal Saxena Minister without Portfolio the.

Examiner trap: First Finance Minister of Free India = R.K. Shanmukham Chetty (1947); First Finance Minister of Republic of India = John Mathai (1950).

qe: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, representing the Scheduled Castes Federation, was appointed as the first Minister of Law in August 1947. In which year did he resign from this post?
qh: अनुसूचित जाति महासंघ (Scheduled Castes Federation) का प्रतिनिधित्व करने वाले डॉ. बी.आर. अंबेडकर को अगस्त 1947 में पहले कानून मंत्री के रूप में नियुक्त किया गया था। उन्होंने इस पद से किस वर्ष इस्तीफा दिया था?
e:
Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Drafting Committee ke Chairman ke sath-sath cabinet ke first Law Minister the.

• Option 1 is Correct because Hindu Code Bill par government aur traditional sections ke beech differences aur policy disagreements ke karan Dr. B.R. Ambedkar ne **September/October 1951** mein Law Minister ke pad se formally resign kar diya tha.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because 1949 mein Constitution adopt hua tha, 1950 mein Shyama Prasad Mookherjee ne resign kiya tha, aur 1953 incorrect date hai.

Examiner trap: Dr. Ambedkar's resignation in 1951 was primarily anchored on the stalling of the progressive Hindu Code Bill.

qe: Which Hindu Mahasabha leader held the portfolio of the Ministry of Industries and Supplies in the first Council of Ministers, holding the distinction of being the first to resign from the cabinet in April 1950?
qh: पहले मंत्रिपरिषद में हिंदू महासभा के किस नेता ने उद्योग और आपूर्ति मंत्रालय का पोर्टफोलियो संभाला था, जिन्हें अप्रैल 1950 में मंत्रिमंडल से इस्तीफा देने वाले पहले व्यक्ति होने का गौरव प्राप्त हुआ था?
e:
Nehru ke pehle broad national coalition cabinet mein diverse ideological streams ke leaders shamil the.

• Option 1 is Correct because Dr. Shyama Prasad Mookherjee ne Industries & Supplies Minister ke roop mein serve kiya aur East Pakistan/Bengal refugee crisis par Nehru-Liaquat Pact (1950) se asahmat hokar April 1950 mein resign kar diya, ban kar pehle minister jinhone cabinet se istifa diya.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because K.C. Neogy ne bhi protest mein thode samay baad resign kiya par primary figure Dr. Mookherjee the, Ayyangar Railway minister bane, aur Rafi Ahmad Kidwai Communications sambhalte rahe.

Examiner trap: Dr. Shyama Prasad Mookherjee resigned in 1950 due to differences over the Delhi Pact (Nehru-Liaquat Pact).

qe: Which minister without portfolio was specifically assigned the task to act as a crucial coordination link between the Union government and the cabinet of the East Punjab government in 1947?
qh: 1947 में केंद्र सरकार और पूर्वी पंजाब सरकार के मंत्रिमंडल के बीच एक महत्वपूर्ण समन्वय लिंक के रूप में कार्य करने का कार्य विशेष रूप से किस बिना विभाग के मंत्री (minister without portfolio) को सौंपा गया था?
e:
Partition violence aur massive refugee influx ke samay East Punjab administration ke sath institutional coordination vital tha.

• Option 1 is Correct because N. Gopalaswami Ayyangar (former Prime Minister of Kashmir) ko Minister without Portfolio banaya gaya tha aur unhe specifically East Punjab government ke sath border issues, refugee rehabilitation aur baad mein Kashmir affairs coordinate karne ki zimmedari di gayi thi.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because Mohanlal Saxena baad mein Rehabilitation minister bane, C.H. Bhabha Commerce minister the, aur Jairamdas Daulatram Food portfolio handle karte the.

Examiner trap: Gopalaswami Ayyangar also drafted Article 370 of the Indian Constitution.

qe: Following the dissolution of absolute British paramountcy over the sub-continent, what milestone occurred on January 26, 1950, regarding India's constitutional status?
qh: उपमहाद्वीप पर पूर्ण ब्रिटिश संप्रभुता (paramountcy) की समाप्ति के बाद, भारत की संवैधानिक स्थिति के संबंध में 26 जनवरी, 1950 को कौन सा मील का पत्थर स्थापित हुआ था?
oe: India formally became a republic and elected Rajendra Prasad as its first President
The temporary Government of India Act 1919 was put into operation for another decade
Jawaharlal Nehru resigned from the post of Prime Minister to dissolve the cabinet framework
Lord Mountbatten was permanently sworn in as the lifelong Governor-General of the Union
oh: भारत औपचारिक रूप से एक गणतंत्र बन गया और राजेंद्र प्रसाद को अपना पहला राष्ट्रपति चुना
अस्थायी भारत सरकार अधिनियम 1919 को एक और दशक के लिए लागू किया गया
मंत्रिमंडल के ढांचे को भंग करने के लिए जवाहरलाल नेहरू ने प्रधानमंत्री पद से इस्तीफा दे दिया
लॉर्ड माउंटबेटन को स्थायी रूप से संघ के आजीवन गवर्नर-जनरल के रूप में शपथ दिलाई गई
e:
15 August 1947 se lekar 25 January 1950 tak India ek British Dominion status par operate kar raha tha under Government of India Act 1935.

• Option 1 is Correct because 26 January 1950 ko Constitution of India fully enforce hua, Dominion status terminate hua, India ek Sovereign Democratic Republic bana, aur Dr. Rajendra Prasad ne first President of India ke roop mein oath li.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because GOI Act 1935 (na ki 1919) transition mein use hua tha jo replace ho gaya, Nehru PM bane rahe, aur Mountbatten June 1948 mein hi India chhod chuke the.

Examiner trap: 26 November 1949 is Constitution Adoption Day (Constitution Day), while 26 January 1950 is Republic Day (Enforcement Day).

qe: A logistical coordinate sensor maps out a precise right-angled triangular configurations grid. A search car moves 24 km North from base station O, and then changes orientation to drive 7 km East to reach target spot B. Calculate the direct straight-line distance from O to B.
qh: एक वाहन डिपो O से 24 किमी उत्तर की ओर चलता है, और फिर दिशा बदलकर पूर्व की ओर 7 किमी जाकर बिंदु B पर पहुँचता है। O से B की सीधी रेखा की दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Two-dimensional Cartesian coordinate grid par directional displacement ek standard Euclidean right-angled triangle construct karta hai.

• Option 1 is Correct because North aur East directions ke beech $90^\circ$ ka angle hota hai. Pythagoras theorem use karke:
$\text{Distance } OB = \sqrt{(\text{North displacement})^2 + (\text{East displacement})^2}$
$OB = \sqrt{24^2 + 7^2} = \sqrt{576 + 49} = \sqrt{625} = 25\text{ km}$.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because 31 km total path distance ($24 + 7$) hai na ki straight-line displacement, aur 28 km/30 km mathematically incorrect values hain.

Examiner trap: Displacement (shortest straight-line distance) is different from total distance traveled.

qe: In a biological ecosystem study tracking energy metrics within an alluvial biome, if the Gross Primary Productivity (GPP) of a forest tract maps to 56,000 units and the measured Net Primary Productivity (NPP) is 36,000 units, calculate the energy spent during plant metabolic respiration (R).
qh: एक पारिस्थितिकी उत्पादकता सर्वेक्षण में, यदि एक वन क्षेत्र की सकल प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (GPP) 56,000 इकाइयाँ है और मापी गई शुद्ध प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (NPP) 36,000 इकाइयाँ है, तो पौधों के श्वसन (R) के दौरान खर्च की गई ऊर्जा की गणना करें।
e:
Ecosystem energetics mein primary productivity photosynthetic energy fixation aur metabolic respiration losses ka balance represent karti hai.

• Option 1 is Correct because basic ecological equation hoti hai: $\text{NPP} = \text{GPP} - R$.
Is formula ko rearrange karke Respiration loss ($R$) nikaalte hain:
$R = \text{GPP} - \text{NPP} = 56,000 - 36,000 = 20,000\text{ units}$.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because 92,000 units GPP aur NPP ka addition ($56,000 + 36,000$) hai jo biologically invalid hai, jabki 30,000 aur 16,000 arithmetic errors hain.

Examiner trap: NPP is always less than GPP because autotrophs continuously utilize energy for their own cellular respiration.

qe: The 'Act for Better Government of India, 1858' introduced a profound constitutional shift in the administrative structure of the sub-continent by executing which measure?
qh: भारत सरकार अधिनियम 1858 ने कौन सा उपाय करके उपमहाद्वीप के प्रशासनिक ढांचे में एक गहरा संवैधानिक बदलाव पेश किया था?
oe: Transferring the power to govern from the East India Company directly to the British Crown, to be wielded through a Secretary of State
Establishing complete provincial autonomy under popular native ministerial portfolios
Abolishing the office of the Viceroy and creating the separate Federal Court structure at Allahabad
Scrapping the supervisory control of the British Parliament over Indian revenues permanently
oh: शासन करने की शक्ति को ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी से सीधे ब्रिटिश क्राउन को हस्तांतरित करना, जिसे राज्य सचिव के माध्यम से इस्तेमाल किया जाना था
लोकप्रिय देशी मंत्रिस्तरीय विभागों के तहत पूर्ण प्रांतीय स्वायत्तता की स्थापना
वायसराय के पद को समाप्त करना और इलाहाबाद में अलग संघीय न्यायालय संरचना का निर्माण करना
भारतीय राजस्व पर ब्रिटिश संसद के पर्यवेक्षी नियंत्रण को स्थायी रूप से समाप्त करना
e:
1857 ke Great Revolt ke response mein British Parliament ne East India Company ke dual administrative failures ko terminate karne ke liye 1858 Act pass kiya.

• Option 1 is Correct because is Act ne East India Company ka rule abolish kiya, Court of Directors aur Board of Control (Dual Government) ko khatam kiya, aur administrative authority British Crown ko transfer ki jo Secretary of State for India aur unki 15-member Council ke through operate hoti thi.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because Provincial Autonomy Government of India Act 1935 mein aayi, Federal Court 1935 Act ke under Delhi mein 1937 mein bana, aur Governor-General ko Viceroy ka additional title diya gaya tha.

Examiner trap: The 1858 Act abolished the Company's rule, not the British rule; it replaced Company sovereignty with Crown direct rule.

qe: What macro-level transformation occurred to India's dynamic share of global manufacturing exports across the centuries of British colonial rule?
qh: ब्रिटिश औपनिवेशिक शासन के सदियों के दौरान वैश्विक विनिर्माण निर्यात (world manufacturing exports) में भारत की गतिशील हिस्सेदारी में कौन सा बड़े पैमाने पर परिवर्तन आया?
oe: It dramatically fell from 27 per cent down to a mere 2 per cent
It increased steadily from 2 per cent up to an optimized 27 per cent
It remained perfectly constant at a balanced 10 per cent layout
It dropped to zero instantly within the first decade of the Charter Act of 1813
oh: यह नाटकीय रूप से 27 प्रतिशत से गिरकर मात्र 2 प्रतिशत पर आ गया
यह लगातार 2 प्रतिशत से बढ़कर अनुकूलित 27 प्रतिशत तक पहुँच गया
यह संतुलित 10 प्रतिशत लेआउट पर पूरी तरह से स्थिर रहा
यह 1813 के चार्टर अधिनियम के पहले दशक के भीतर तुरंत शून्य हो गया
e:
Colonial trade policies, one-way free trade, discriminatory tariffs aur forced de-industrialization ne India ke indigenous handicrafts aur textile industries ko collapse kar diya.

• Option 1 is Correct because economic historians (jaise Angus Maddison aur Paul Bairoch) ke data ke अनुसार early 18th century (pre-colonial era) mein global manufacturing output mein India ka share lagbhag 25-27 per cent tha, jo British rule ke drain of wealth aur de-industrialization ke chalte 1947 tak collapse hokar sirf ~2 per cent reh gaya.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because colonial trade policy ne industrialization ko reverse (de-industrialize) kiya tha na ki grow ya constant rakha.

Examiner trap: Colonial rule transformed India from a premier exporter of manufactured silk/cotton goods into a net exporter of raw materials and importer of finished British goods.

qe: The judicial framework of the Cornwallis Code of 1793 established a major milestone in modern Indian administrative history by firmly introducing which concept?
qh: 1793 के 'कॉर्नवॉलिस कोड' ने किस प्रमुख अवधारणा को दृढ़ता से पेश करके आधुनिक भारतीय प्रशासनिक इतिहास में एक बुनियादी मील का पत्थर स्थापित किया?
oe: The principle of the sovereignty of law and the separation of revenue and justice administration
The absolute legal immunity of all colonial government officials from civil court oversight
The mandatory use of English instead of vernacular languages across all local lower subdivisions
The total structural centralization of all judicial functions under the district Collector
oh: कानून की संप्रभुता का सिद्धांत और राजस्व एवं न्याय प्रशासन का पृथक्करण
दीवानी अदालत की निगरानी से सभी औपनिवेशिक सरकारी अधिकारियों की पूर्ण कानूनी उन्मुक्ति
सभी स्थानीय निचले उप-विभागों में स्थानीय भाषाओं के स्थान पर अंग्रेजी का अनिवार्य उपयोग
जिला कलेक्टर के अधीन सभी न्यायिक कार्यों का पूर्ण संरचनात्मक केंद्रीकरण
e:
Lord Cornwallis ne administrative efficiency aur judicial transparency ke liye 1793 mein legal regulations ka compilation 'Cornwallis Code' enact kiya.

• Option 1 is Correct because Cornwallis Code ne **Separation of Powers** establish kiya: District Collector se judicial/magisterial powers chheen kar purely revenue collection tak limit kiya gaya, District Judges ka separate office banaya, aur government officials ko unke official acts ke liye civil courts ke prati accountable banaya (Sovereignty of Law).
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because officials ko legal immunity nahi di gayi balki courts ke subject banaya gaya, Collector ko judicial power se divest kiya gaya, aur lower courts mein Persian/vernacular use hota raha.

Examiner trap: Cornwallis separated revenue from judicial functions, whereas Warren Hastings had previously combined them in the Collector.

qe: In 1860, a judicial modification regulated the privileges of European subjects in India. What restriction did it place on judges of Indian origin regarding criminal cases?
qh: 1860 में, एक न्यायिक संशोधन ने भारत में यूरोपीय विषयों के विशेषाधिकारों को विनियमित किया। इसने आपराधिक मामलों के संबंध में भारतीय मूल के न्यायाधीशों पर कौन सा प्रतिबंध लगाया था?
oe: No judge of an Indian origin could legally try a European subject in a criminal case
Indian judges were stripped of any original jurisdiction over civil property disputes involving Europeans
They were legally forced to refer all native criminal files directly to the local Munsiff benches
Indian judges were required to pass all their sentences strictly in classical European ciphers
oh: कोई भी भारतीय मूल का न्यायाधीश आपराधिक मामले में कानूनी रूप से किसी यूरोपीय विषय पर मुकदमा नहीं चला सकता था
भारतीय न्यायाधीशों को यूरोपीय लोगों से जुड़े नागरिक संपत्ति विवादों पर किसी भी मूल अधिकार क्षेत्र से वंचित कर दिया गया था
वे सभी देशी आपराधिक फाइलों को सीधे स्थानीय मुंसिफ पीठों को संदर्भित करने के लिए कानूनी रूप से मजबूर थे
भारतीय न्यायाधीशों को अपने सभी वाक्यों को शास्त्रीय यूरोपीय सिफर में सख्ती से पारित करने की आवश्यकता थी
e:
Colonial judicial framework inherent racial discrimination aur institutional inequality par constructed tha.

• Option 1 is Correct because 1860 ke legal modifications aur Criminal Procedure Code (CrPC) ke provisions ke tehat mofussil (district) courts mein kisi bhi Indian origin ke magistrate ya judge ko European British subjects ke criminal cases try karne ka right nahi tha, jise baad mein 1883 ke Ilbert Bill controversy mein challenge kiya gaya.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because civil disputes mein Indian judges Europeans ke cases dekh sakte the par criminal trials par strict racial bar tha.

Examiner trap: This racial disparity in criminal jurisdiction set the stage for the historic Ilbert Bill controversy during Lord Ripon’s viceroyalty in 1883.

qe: Under the central executive guidelines of the Government of India Act, 1919, what specific bicameral houses had replaced the old unicameral Imperial Legislative Council?
qh: भारत सरकार अधिनियम 1919 के केंद्रीय कार्यकारी दिशानिर्देशों के तहत, किन विशिष्ट द्विसदनीय सदनों ने पुरानी एकसदनीय इंपीरियल लेजिस्लेटिव काउंसिल का स्थान लिया था?
oe: The Central Legislative Assembly (lower house) and the Council of State (upper house)
The House of Commons and the House of Lords structural branches
The British Indian Association and the All India Kisan Sabha chambers
The Sadar Diwani Adalat and the Sadar Nizamat legislative divisions
oh: केंद्रीय विधान सभा (निचला सदन) और राज्य परिषद (उच्च सदन)
हाउस ऑफ कॉमन्स और हाउस ऑफ लॉर्ड्स संरचनात्मक शाखाएँ
ब्रिटिश इंडियन एसोसिएशन और अखिल भारतीय किसान सभा कक्ष
सदर दीवानी अदालत और सदर निजामत विधायी प्रभाग
e:
Montagu-Chelmsford Reforms ke basis par enacted Government of India Act 1919 ne central level par bicameralism introduce kiya.

• Option 1 is Correct because Imperial Legislative Council ko replace karke do houses banaye gaye: **Council of State** (Upper House, 5-year tenure) aur **Central Legislative Assembly** (Lower House, 3-year tenure), jisme majority elected members the.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because House of Commons British Parliament mein hai, Sadar Adalat judicial body thi, aur BIA/AIKS political/peasant associations the.

Examiner trap: Dyarchy was introduced at the *Provincial* level in 1919, while *Bicameralism* and direct elections were introduced at the *Central* level.

qe: The Royal Commission on Decentralization (1908) made a critical recommendation regarding the financial and administrative responsibilities of urban municipalities. What role did it suggest they should play in primary education?
qh: रॉयल कमीशन ऑन विकेंद्रीकरण (1908) ने शहरी नगर पालिकाओं की वित्तीय और प्रशासनिक जिम्मेदारियों के संबंध में एक महत्वपूर्ण सिफारिश की थी। इसने प्राथमिक शिक्षा में उनकी क्या भूमिका सुझाया था?
oe: The municipalities might explicitly undertake the responsibility for primary education and, if willing, for middle vernacular schools
They should be completely barred from funding or managing any primary-level educational facilities locally
They were legally forced to route 100% of their primary school tax revenues directly to the Dayal Singh Trust in Lahore
The Commission suggested that municipalities should manage only high-cost advanced technical engineering universities
oh: नगरपालिकाएँ स्पष्ट रूप से प्राथमिक शिक्षा और, यदि चाहें तो, माध्यमिक स्थानीय भाषा स्कूलों की जिम्मेदारी ले सकती हैं
उन्हें स्थानीय स्तर पर किसी भी प्राथमिक स्तर की शैक्षिक सुविधाओं के वित्तपोषण या प्रबंधन से पूरी तरह से प्रतिबंधित किया जाना चाहिए
वे अपने प्राथमिक स्कूल कर राजस्व का 100% सीधे लाहौर में दयाल सिंह ट्रस्ट को भेजने के लिए कानूनी रूप से मजबूर थे
आयोग ने सुझाव दिया कि नगर पालिकाओं को केवल उच्च लागत वाले उन्नत तकनीकी इंजीनियरिंग विश्वविद्यालयों का प्रबंधन करना चाहिए
e:
Lord Hobhouse ki chairmanship mein 1907-1908 mein Royal Commission on Decentralization banaya gaya tha taaki local self-government ko improve kiya ja sake.

• Option 1 is Correct because Commission ne recommend kiya ki urban municipal bodies ko financial resources ke sath primary education ki direct responsibility deni chahiye aur voluntary basis par middle vernacular schools ka control bhi diya ja sakta hai, jabki higher education state control mein rahe.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because Commission local bodies ki utility aur educational responsibilities expand karne ke favour mein tha.

Examiner trap: The 1908 Commission emphasized village panchayats and municipal responsibility specifically for primary/elementary education.

qe: What retrogressive evaluation did the Simon Commission outline in its May 1930 report regarding the efficiency and financial management of local self-governing bodies since 1919?
qh: साइमन कमीशन ने मई 1930 की अपनी रिपोर्ट में 1919 के बाद से स्थानीय स्वशासी निकायों के कुशल और वित्तीय प्रबंधन के संबंध में कौन सा प्रतिगामी (retrogressive) मूल्यांकन प्रस्तुत किया था?
oe: It claimed that the management of finances had deteriorated, and suggested the retrograde step of increasing provincial bureaucratic control over local bodies
It celebrated the village panchayats for successfully achieving absolute financial independence across all provinces
It demanded that 100% of local tax revenues must be channeled directly to support the All India Kisan Sabha
The Commission recommended the complete permanent legal abolition of the office of the district magistrate
oh: इसने दावा किया कि वित्त प्रबंधन बिगड़ गया था, और स्थानीय निकायों पर प्रांतीय नौकरशाही नियंत्रण बढ़ाने के प्रतिगामी कदम का सुझाव दिया
इसने सभी प्रांतों में पूर्ण वित्तीय स्वतंत्रता सफलतापूर्वक प्राप्त करने के लिए ग्राम पंचायतों की सराहना की
इसने मांग की कि स्थानीय कर राजस्व का 100% सीधे अखिल भारतीय किसान सभा का समर्थन करने के लिए भेजा जाना चाहिए
आयोग ने जिला मजिस्ट्रेट के कार्यालय के पूर्ण स्थायी कानूनी उन्मूलन की सिफारिश की
e:
Simon Commission (Indian Statutory Commission) ne May 1930 mein apni report submit ki thi jisme 1919 Act ke operational working ko assess kiya gaya tha.

• Option 1 is Correct because Commission ne conclude kiya ki Indian ministers ke under local bodies ka financial management deteriorate hua hai aur efficiency gir gayi hai; is justification ke sath unhone administrative efficiency ke naam par bureaucratic aur governmental control badhane ki retrograde recommendation di.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because Simon report local democracy ko praise karne ke bajaye critical aur centralizing tone mein draft ki gayi thi.

Examiner trap: The Simon Commission used financial inefficiency as an excuse to advocate tighter bureaucratic reins on Indian local bodies.

qe: What was the significance of the resolution on 'Fundamental Rights' passed at the 1931 Karachi Congress session?
qh: 1931 के कराची कांग्रेस सत्र में पारित 'मौलिक अधिकारों' (Fundamental Rights) के प्रस्ताव का महत्व क्या था?
oe: It guaranteed free speech, free press, universal adult franchise, and state neutrality in religious matters
It formally restricted the voting rights exclusively to wealthy aristocratic landowners
It established the British managing agencies as the ultimate authority over Indian education
It mandated the compulsory use of foreign textiles inside all public government offices
oh: इसने स्वतंत्र भाषण, स्वतंत्र प्रेस, सार्वभौमिक वयस्क मताधिकार और धार्मिक मामलों में राज्य की तटस्थता की गारंटी दी
इसने औपचारिक रूप से मतदान के अधिकारों को केवल धनी कुलीन जमींदारों तक ही सीमित कर दिया
इसने भारतीय शिक्षा पर ब्रिटिश प्रबंध एजेंसियों को अंतिम प्राधिकरण के रूप में स्थापित किया
इसने सभी सार्वजनिक सरकारी कार्यालयों के अंदर विदेशी वस्त्रों के अनिवार्य उपयोग का आदेश दिया
e:
Karachi Congress Session (March 1931), presided over by Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, Indian freedom struggle ka landmark ideological moment tha.

• Option 1 is Correct because Karachi Resolution (drafted by Jawaharlal Nehru) ne first time Free India ke basic democratic framework ko define kiya: Freedom of speech and press, freedom of association, universal adult franchise, equal rights irrespective of caste/religion, aur State neutrality in religious affairs (secularism).
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because resolution adult suffrage aur socioeconomic justice promote karta tha na ki aristocratic property franchise.

Examiner trap: Karachi 1931 passed two monumental resolutions: one on 'Fundamental Rights' and another on the 'National Economic Programme'.

qe: During the mid-1920s, the internal unity of the Swarajist Party fractured along a communal and strategic divide. What were the two competing camps that emerged within the party?
qh: 1920 के दशक के मध्य के दौरान, स्वराजवादी पार्टी की आंतरिक एकता सांप्रदायिक और रणनीतिक विभाजन के कारण टूट गई। पार्टी के भीतर उभरने वाले दो प्रतिस्पर्धी खेमे कौन से थे?
oe: The Moderates and the Extremists structural wings
The Atmiya Sabha and the Dharma Sabha coalitions
The Akali satyagrahis and the Udasi mahant loyalists
oh: आत्मीय सभा और धर्म सभा गठबंधन
अकाली सत्याग्रही और उदासी महंत वफादार
e:
1925 mein C.R. Das ki death ke baad Swarajists ke beech legislative obstruction aur office acceptance ko lekar ideological split ho gaya.

• Option 1 is Correct because party do factions mein split ho gayi: **Responsivists** (Madhan Mohan Malaviya, Lala Lajpat Rai, N.C. Kelkar) jo government offices accept karke Hindu interests aur reforms cooperate karna chahte the; aur **Non-responsivists** (Motilal Nehru) jinhone continuous legislative obstruction aur non-cooperation ki policy maintain ki.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because Moderates/Extremists 1907 Surat split se jude hain, Atmiya/Dharma Sabha 19th-century social reform groups the, aur Akali/Udasi Sikh Gurdwara movement se linked the.

Examiner trap: Responsivists favored working the reformed councils to protect communal/national interests, whereas Non-responsivists staged repeated walkouts.

qe: The British Secretary of State for India, Edwin Montagu, issued a historic statement in August 1917. What did this declaration designate as the ultimate long-term goal of British policy in India?
qh: भारत के ब्रिटिश राज्य सचिव एडविन मोंटेग्यू ने अगस्त 1917 में एक ऐतिहासिक बयान जारी किया था। इस घोषणा ने भारत में ब्रिटिश नीति के अंतिम दीर्घकालिक लक्ष्य के रूप में किसे नामित किया था?
oe: The progressive realization of responsible self-government for the people of India
The permanent administrative annexation of all independent princely states directly to the Crown
The complete structural termination of any Indian representation inside executive councils
The mandatory introduction of centralized non-competitive allosteric inhibitors inside all schools
oh: भारत के लोगों के लिए जिम्मेदार स्वशासन की क्रमिक प्राप्ति
सभी स्वतंत्र रियासतों का सीधे क्राउन में स्थायी प्रशासनिक विलय
कार्यकारी परिषदों के अंदर किसी भी भारतीय प्रतिनिधित्व की पूर्ण संरचनात्मक समाप्ति
सभी स्कूलों के अंदर केंद्रीकृत गैर-प्रतिस्पर्धी एलोस्टेरिक अवरोधकों का अनिवार्य परिचय
e:
Home Rule League Movement aur World War I ke pressures ke response mein British Government ne apni imperial policy reformulate ki.

• Option 1 is Correct because 20 August 1917 ko Edwin Montagu ne House of Commons mein declare kiya ki British policy ka aim "increasing association of Indians in every branch of administration and the gradual development of self-governing institutions with a view to the progressive realization of responsible government in India as an integral part of the British Empire".
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because statement ne self-government ki taraf institutional trajectory set ki thi na ki direct annexation ya political exclusion.

Examiner trap: Montagu's Declaration (August 1917) promised 'Responsible Government' (Northbrook/Curzon concepts were replaced), forming the preamble of the 1919 Act.

qe: Which of the following constitutional decisions was NOT taken during the historic December 1929 Lahore session of the Indian National Congress?
qh: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के ऐतिहासिक दिसंबर 1929 के लाहौर सत्र के दौरान निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा संवैधानिक निर्णय नहीं लिया गया था?
oe: To accept the invitation to participate fully in the upcoming London Round Table Conference
Complete independence was formally declared as the ultimate aim of the Congress
The Congress Working Committee was authorized to launch a programme of civil disobedience including non-payment of taxes
All members of the colonial legislatures were asked to immediately resign their seats
oh: आगामी लंदन गोलमेज सम्मेलन में पूरी तरह से भाग लेने के निमंत्रण को स्वीकार करना
पूर्ण स्वतंत्रता को औपचारिक रूप से कांग्रेस के अंतिम उद्देश्य के रूप में घोषित किया गया था
कांग्रेस कार्य समिति को करों का भुगतान न करने सहित सविनय अवज्ञा का कार्यक्रम शुरू करने के लिए अधिकृत किया गया था
औपनिवेशिक विधायिकाओं के सभी सदस्यों को अपनी सीटों से तुरंत इस्तीफा देने के लिए कहा गया था
e:
Jawaharlal Nehru ki presidency ke under Lahore Session (December 1929) Indian national movement ka turning point tha jahan radical stance adopt kiya gaya.

• Option 1 is Correct (as the action NOT taken) because Lahore Congress ne Round Table Conference ko completely **boycott** karne ka resolution pass kiya tha, accept karne ka nahi.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect (actions actually taken) because session ne 'Purna Swaraj' adopt kiya, 26 January 1930 ko Independence Day declare kiya, council boycott ka aadesh diya, aur CWC ko Civil Disobedience Movement launch karne ke full powers diye.

Examiner trap: Read negative stems ('NOT taken') carefully; Congress boycotted the 1st RTC and only attended the 2nd RTC following the Gandhi-Irwin Pact.

qe: Which legendary young woman revolutionary died heroically while actively conducting a daring armed raid on the Pahartali European Club in Chittagong?
qh: चटगाँव में पहाड़तली यूरोपीय क्लब (Pahartali European Club) पर एक साहसिक सशस्त्र छापे को सक्रिय रूप से अंजाम देते समय किस महान युवा महिला क्रांतिकारी की वीरतापूर्ण मृत्यु हो गई थी?
e:
Surya Sen (Masterda) ke Indian Republican Army (Chittagong Branch) ne national movement mein women revolutionaries ko direct combat operations mein shamil kiya.

• Option 1 is Correct because September 1932 mein Surya Sen ke nirdesh par Pritilata Waddedar ne Pahartali European Club par armed attack lead kiya; police siege mein ghayal hone ke baad capture hone se bachne ke liye unhone Potassium Cyanide swallow karke martyrdom embrace kiya.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because Kalpana Dutt arrest hui thin aur life imprisonment mila, Santi Ghosh ne District Magistrate Stevens ko shoot kiya tha, aur Bina Das ne Bengal Governor Stanley Jackson par convocation mein goli chalayi thi.

Examiner trap: Pritilata Waddedar died during the Pahartali raid; Kalpana Dutt was tried and sentenced to transportation for life.

qe: Under the system of Dyarchy introduced by the Government of India Act 1919 at the provincial level, how were the administrative subjects systematically divided?
qh: प्रांतीय स्तर पर भारत सरकार अधिनियम 1919 द्वारा शुरू किए गए द्वैध शासन (Dyarchy) के संरचनात्मक तंत्र के तहत, प्रांतीय प्रशासनिक विषयों को व्यवस्थित रूप से कैसे विभाजित किया गया था?
oe: Into 'Reserved' subjects (like law and order, finance) and 'Transferred' subjects (like education, health)
Into central maritime trading licenses and local sub-infeudation land lists
Into exclusive religious shastra portfolios and secular judicial codes
Into non-votable military expenditures and open external export duty limits
oh: 'आरक्षित' विषयों (जैसे कानून और व्यवस्था, वित्त) और 'हस्तांतरित' विषयों (जैसे शिक्षा, स्वास्थ्य) में
केंद्रीय समुद्री व्यापारिक लाइसेंस और स्थानीय उप-सामंती भूमि सूचियों में
विशेष धार्मिक शास्त्र विभागों और धर्मनिरपेक्ष न्यायिक संहिताओं में
गैर-मतदेय सैन्य व्यय और खुले बाहरी निर्यात शुल्क सीमाओं में
e:
Dyarchy (Rule of Two) Government of India Act 1919 ka core feature tha jise provincial administration par apply kiya gaya tha.

• Option 1 is Correct because Provincial subjects ko do categories mein split kiya gaya tha: **Reserved Subjects** (Law & Order, Finance, Land Revenue, Police) jo Governor aur unki bureaucratic Executive Council bina legislature ke prati responsible hue chalate the; aur **Transferred Subjects** (Education, Public Health, Agriculture, Local Self-Govt) jo elected Indian ministers ko diye gaye the.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because ye fictitious categories hain jo colonial constitutional classification ka hissa nahi thin.

Examiner trap: Finance and Police were 'Reserved' (with British Executive Council), while Education and Health were 'Transferred' (with Indian Ministers lacking funds).

qe: Who served as the Minister of Health within the first Council of Ministers of independent India, establishing historical importance as a pioneering woman cabinet executive?
qh: स्वतंत्र भारत के पहले मंत्रिपरिषद के भीतर स्वास्थ्य मंत्री (Minister of Health) के रूप में किसने कार्य किया, जिन्होंने एक अग्रणी महिला कैबिनेट कार्यकारी के रूप में ऐतिहासिक महत्व स्थापित किया?
e:
Rajkumari Amrit Kaur Gandhian follower, freedom fighter aur Kapurthala princely state lineage se belong karti thin.

• Option 1 is Correct because Rajkumari Amrit Kaur independent India ke pehle cabinet mein sole woman member thin aur unhone first Minister of Health ke roop mein All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) ki foundation rakhi.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because Sarojini Naidu United Provinces (UP) ki first woman Governor bani thin, Begum Shahnawaz Muslim League politics se thin, aur Radhabai Subbarayan first female member of Council of State thin.

Examiner trap: Rajkumari Amrit Kaur was the first female *Cabinet Minister* of India, while Sarojini Naidu was the first female *Governor*.

qe: Who among the following national figures assumed charge of the Ministry of Communications inside the 1947 Council of Ministers?
qh: निम्नलिखित राष्ट्रीय हस्तियों में से किसने 1947 के मंत्रिपरिषद के भीतर संचार मंत्रालय (Ministry of Communications) का प्रभार संभाला था?
e:
First Union Cabinet mein administrative departments ko efficiently function karne ke liye seasoned nationalist administrators ko assign kiya gaya tha.

• Option 1 is Correct because UP ke prominent nationalist leader Rafi Ahmad Kidwai ne 1947 Council of Ministers mein Minister of Communications ka charge sambhala tha aur Postal night airmail service introduce ki thi.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because Mohanlal Saxena Minister without Portfolio the, N.V. Gadgil Works, Mines and Power ke minister the, aur Jairamdas Daulatram Food & Agriculture portfolio hold karte the.

Examiner trap: Rafi Ahmad Kidwai later became famous for successfully handling the difficult Food and Agriculture Ministry during food rationing days in the 1950s.

qe: The portfolio of Works, Mines and Power inside the first executive Council of Ministers was assigned to which minister?
qh: पहले कार्यकारी मंत्रिपरिषद के भीतर कार्य, खान और बिजली (Works, Mines and Power) का पोर्टफोलियो किस मंत्री को सौंपा गया था?
e:
Post-independence infrastructure, river valley projects aur mineral resource development central government ki priority thin.

• Option 1 is Correct because Maharashtra ke prominent Congress leader Narhar Vishnu Gadgil (Kakasaheb Gadgil) ko 1947 mein Minister of Works, Mines and Power banaya gaya; unhone Bhakra Nangal aur Damodar Valley projects ki early planning facilitate ki.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because C.H. Bhabha Commerce Minister the, K.C. Neogy Relief & Rehabilitation minister bane, aur Babu Jagjivan Ram first Labour Minister the.

Examiner trap: N.V. Gadgil (Works, Mines & Power) is distinct from D.R. Gadgil (the economist associated with the Gadgil formula of Planning Commission).

qe: Who was designated as the Minister of Food and Agriculture within the independent Indian cabinet sworn in on August 15, 1947?
qh: 15 अगस्त, 1947 को शपथ लेने वाले स्वतंत्र भारतीय मंत्रिमंडल के भीतर खाद्य और कृषि मंत्री (Minister of Food and Agriculture) के रूप में किसे नामित किया गया था?
e:
Post-partition food shortages aur agrarian management independent India ke immediate administrative challenges the.

• Option 1 is Correct because Sindh ke veteran freedom fighter Jairamdas Daulatram ne 1947 cabinet mein Minister of Food and Agriculture ka charge sambhala (Dr. Rajendra Prasad ke Interim Government role ke baad).
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because John Mathai Railways handle karte the, Shanmukham Chetty Finance sambhalte the, aur Shyama Prasad Mookherjee Industries and Supplies ke in-charge the.

Examiner trap: In the 1946 Interim Government, Food & Agriculture was held by Dr. Rajendra Prasad; in the August 1947 Cabinet, Jairamdas Daulatram took charge.

qe: During the mid-1930s, many new entrants to active politics took to organizing the peasantry. What structural reason prompted this search for new suitable outlets?
qh: 1930 के दशक के मध्य के दौरान, सक्रिय राजनीति में कई नए प्रवेशकों ने किसानों को संगठित करने का काम किया। किस संरचनात्मक कारण ने नए उपयुक्त आउटलेट की इस खोज को प्रेरित किया था?
oe: The decline of the active phase of the mass movement in 1932 left them looking for outlets to release their energies
The British administration offered flat cash financial subsidies to organize peasant cells
The total legal nationalization of all corporate industries inside towns forced them into rural zones
They were mandated by a direct text decree of the newly established Federal Court to stay in villages
oh: 1932 में जन आंदोलन के सक्रिय चरण की गिरावट ने उन्हें अपनी ऊर्जा को मुक्त करने के लिए नए रास्ते तलाशने के लिए छोड़ दिया
ब्रिटिश प्रशासन ने किसान इकाइयों को संगठित करने के लिए नकद वित्तीय सब्सिडी की पेशकश की
शहरों के अंदर सभी कॉर्पोरेट उद्योगों के पूर्ण कानूनी राष्ट्रीयकरण ने उन्हें ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में जाने के लिए मजबूर किया
उन्हें नए स्थापित संघीय न्यायालय के एक प्रत्यक्ष पाठ डिक्री द्वारा गांवों में रहने का आदेश दिया गया था
e:
Civil Disobedience Movement ke suspension (1932-34) ke baad Indian politics mein ek temporary political vacuum create hua tha.

• Option 1 is Correct because jab Gandhiji ne active mass civil disobedience call off kiya, tab younger socialist aur left-leaning cadres (Congress Socialist Party, Communists) ne apni political energy ko channelize karne ke liye grassroot level par peasant (Kisan) aur trade union organizations build karna shuru kiya.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because British administration kisan organizations ko suppress karti thi na ki subsidy deti thi, aur koi industrial nationalization ya court decree issue nahi hua tha.

Examiner trap: The suspension of Civil Disobedience directly catalyzed the emergence of the Congress Socialist Party (1934) and the All India Kisan Sabha (1936).

qe: What precise macro-level impact did the All India Kisan Sabha agenda produce on the 1937 provincial elections?
qh: अखिल भारतीय किसान सभा के एजेंडे ने 1937 के प्रांतीय चुनावों पर क्या सटीक व्यापक स्तर (macro-level) का प्रभाव डाला था?
oe: The Congress election manifesto, especially its agrarian policy, was strongly influenced by the AIKS agenda
The AIKS completely banned any Congress candidate from contesting seats in Bihar and UP
It forced the absolute liquidation of all provincial ministries running under the 1935 Act layout
The agenda led to the total elimination of separate communal electorates from rural fields
oh: कांग्रेस का चुनाव घोषणापत्र, विशेष रूप से इसकी कृषि नीति, AIKS एजेंडे से काफी प्रभावित थी
AIKS ने बिहार और यूपी में किसी भी कांग्रेस उम्मीदवार के चुनाव लड़ने पर पूरी तरह से प्रतिबंध लगा दिया
इसने 1935 अधिनियम लेआउट के तहत चल रहे सभी प्रांतीय मंत्रालयों के पूर्ण परिसमापन को मजबूर किया
इस एजेंडे के कारण ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों से पृथक सांप्रदायिक निर्वाचक मंडल पूरी तरह समाप्त हो गए
e:
All India Kisan Sabha ne nationwide mass mobilization karke national leadership par strong radical pressure banaya tha.

• Option 1 is Correct because AIKS ke Kisan Manifesto (July 1936) jisme 50% rent reduction, debt moratorium, aur abolition of zamindari demand ki gayi thi, ne Congress ke 1937 Election Manifesto aur Faizpur Agrarian Programme ko decisively shape kiya.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because AIKS ne Congress candidates ko elect karne mein actively help ki thi na ki ban kiya tha, aur communal electorates 1935 Act ke provisions the jo eliminate nahi hue the.

Examiner trap: In 1937, Kisan Sabha worked in tandem with Congress to ensure massive electoral victories in provinces like Bihar, UP, and Madras.

qe: Who served as the very first Governor-General of independent India immediately following the transfer of power on August 15, 1947?
qh: 15 अगस्त, 1947 को सत्ता के हस्तांतरण के तुरंत बाद स्वतंत्र भारत के पहले गवर्नर-जनरल के रूप में किसने कार्य किया था?
e:
Indian Independence Act 1947 ke tehat do independent dominions create kiye gaye the, jisme dono dominions ko apna Governor-General appoint karne ka provision tha.

• Option 1 is Correct because Indian leadership ne transition period ke dauran administrative stability maintain karne ke liye Lord Mountbatten ko independent Dominion of India ka first Governor-General continue karne ka request kiya (August 1947 - June 1948).
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because C. Rajagopalachari June 1948 mein second Governor-General bane, Dr. Rajendra Prasad 1950 mein President bane, aur Nehru Prime Minister the.

Examiner trap: First Governor-General of Independent India = Lord Mountbatten; First *Indian* Governor-General of Independent India = C. Rajagopalachari.

qe: Who holds the distinction of being the first Indian national to serve as the Governor-General of the country before it transformed into a republic in 1950?
qh: 1950 में गणतंत्र में बदलने से पहले देश के गवर्नर-जनरल के रूप में कार्य करने वाले पहले भारतीय नागरिक होने का गौरव किसे प्राप्त है?
e:
Lord Mountbatten ke resignation ke baad Indian Dominion ke executive head ka role ek prominent Indian nationalist ko transfer kiya gaya.

• Option 1 is Correct because veteran statesman Chakravarti Rajagopalachari (Rajaji) June 1948 se 26 January 1950 tak first (aur only) Indian national bane jinhone Governor-General of India ka post hold kiya.
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because Rajendra Prasad first President bane (not Governor-General), jabki Nehru PM aur Patel Deputy PM the.

Examiner trap: C. Rajagopalachari was both the first Indian Governor-General and the last Governor-General of India.

qe: Which minister without portfolio held office inside the first Council of Ministers of independent India alongside Narasimha Gopalaswami Ayyangar?
qh: स्वतंत्र भारत के पहले मंत्रिपरिषद में नरसिम्हा गोपालस्वामी अय्यंगार के साथ किस बिना विभाग के मंत्री (minister without portfolio) ने पद संभाला था?
e:
1947 ke post-partition crises ke doraan specific strategic aur cross-departmental coordination ke liye ministers without portfolio appoint kiye gaye the.

• Option 1 is Correct because Mohanlal Saxena ne N. Gopalaswami Ayyangar ke sath initial first ministry mein Minister without Portfolio serve kiya (baad mein unhe Relief and Rehabilitation portfolio assign kiya gaya).
• Option 2, 3 and 4 are Incorrect because K.C. Neogy, C.H. Bhabha (Commerce), aur Rafi Ahmad Kidwai (Communications) defined ministerial portfolios hold karte the.

Examiner trap: In 1947, Mohanlal Saxena and N. Gopalaswami Ayyangar were the two specific designated Ministers without Portfolio.

qe: Consider the following statements regarding the dynamic modes of coercion and structural response witnessed during the Indigo Revolt of 1859 in Bengal:
qh: बंगाल में 1859 के नील विद्रोह के दौरान देखे गए जबरदस्ती के गतिशील तरीकों और संरचनात्मक प्रतिक्रिया के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
se: European planters systematically forced local peasants to cultivate indigo on their lands by utilizing fraudulent contracts and advance sums.
The native peasantry initial explosion of anger was masterminded under the regional leadership of Digambar Biswas and Bishnu Biswas in Nadia district.
The ryots backed down instantly when planters implemented evictions, choosing to pay enhanced rents without staging any structured strikes.
sh: यूरोपीय बागान मालिकों ने धोखाधड़ी वाले अनुबंधों और अग्रिम राशियों का उपयोग करके स्थानीय किसानों को अपनी भूमि पर नील की खेती करने के लिए व्यवस्थित रूप से मजबूर किया।
नदिया जिले में दिगंबर बिस्वास और बिष्णु बिस्वास के क्षेत्रीय नेतृत्व में देशी किसानों के गुस्से का प्रारंभिक विस्फोट हुआ था।
जब बागान मालिकों ने बेदखली लागू की तो रैयतों ने तुरंत घुटने टेक दिए, और बिना किसी संगठित हड़ताल के बढ़े हुए किराए का भुगतान करना चुना।
oe: More than one of the above / None of the above
oh: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक / उपर्युक्त में से कोई नहीं
e:
Indigo Revolt (Neel Bidroho) of 1859-60 Bengal ke Nadia, Pabna, Jessore aur Murshidabad districts mein European planters ke coercive system ke khilaf shuru hua ek landmark peasant rebellion tha.

• Statement 1 is Correct because European planters ryots ko advance loans (Dadon system) aur fraudulent deeds ke zariye food crops (rice) ke bajaye unremunerative indigo grow karne ke liye coerce karte the.
• Statement 2 is Correct because movement ka open outburst autumn 1859 mein Govindpur village (Nadia district) mein hua, jise do former employees Digambar Biswas aur Bishnu Charan Biswas ne organize aur lead kiya.
• Statement 3 is Incorrect because ryots ne surrender nahi kiya; unhone complete rent strike (no-rent campaign) stage kiya, planters ke private militia (lathiyals) ko physically confront kiya aur legal courts mein organized defense present kiya.

Examiner trap: Dinabandhu Mitra's play 'Nil Darpan' (1860) portrayed this specific planters' oppression and ryots' resistance.

qe: What final administrative notifications and industrial market adjustments officially brought an end to Indigo cultivation in Bengal by late 1860?
qh: 1860 के उत्तरार्ध तक बंगाल में नील की खेती को आधिकारिक तौर पर समाप्त करने वाले अंतिम प्रशासनिक नोटिफिकेशन और औद्योगिक बाजार समायोजन क्या थे?
se: The colonial state appointed an indigo commission whose clear recommendations led to a November 1860 notification that ryots could not be compelled to grow indigo.
The legislative notification successfully pacified European planters, who expanded their factories robustly by offering high wages to the peasantry.
Planters proactively began closing down their processing factories, causing indigo cultivation to be virtually wiped out from Bengal by the end of 1860.
sh: औपनिवेशिक राज्य ने एक नील आयोग नियुक्त किया जिसकी स्पष्ट सिफारिशों के कारण नवंबर 1860 में एक अधिसूचना जारी की गई कि रैयतों को नील उगाने के लिए मजबूर नहीं किया जा सकता है।
विधायी अधिसूचना ने यूरोपीय बागान मालिकों को सफलतापूर्वक शांत कर दिया, जिन्होंने किसानों को उच्च मजदूरी की पेशकश करके अपने कारखानों का मजबूती से विस्तार किया।
बागान मालिकों ने सक्रिय रूप से अपने प्रसंस्करण कारखानों को बंद करना शुरू कर दिया, जिससे 1860 के अंत तक बंगाल से नील की खेती व्यावहारिक रूप से समाप्त हो गई।
oe: More than one of the above / None of the above
oh: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक / उपर्युक्त में से कोई नहीं
e:
Indigo Revolt 19th-century British India ka ek exceptionally successful peasant movement tha jisme colonial government ko institutional legal reforms lane pade.

• Statement 1 is Correct because ryot resistance ke chalte government ne W.S. Seton-Karr ki chairmanship mein Indigo Commission (1860) appoint kiya, jiski findings par November 1860 notification issue hua ki indigo cultivation ryot ki absolute voluntary choice hai aur unhe force nahi kiya ja sakta.
• Statement 2 is Incorrect because planters pacify nahi hue aur na hi unhone factories expand keen; bina coercion ke voluntary system unke liye unviable ho gaya tha.
• Statement 3 is Correct because voluntary status aane ke baad Bengal ke planters ne rapidly apni factories shut down karna shuru kar diya, aur indigo production Bengal se completely wipe out hokar Bihar shift ho gaya.

Examiner trap: Indigo cultivation did not modernize in Bengal; it collapsed entirely and relocated to Bihar (setting up the context for Champaran 1917).

qe: Analyze the underlying structural causes and legal parameter traps that triggered the widespread agrarian unrest in Eastern Bengal during the 1870s and 1880s:
qh: 1870 और 1880 के दशक के दौरान पूर्वी बंगाल में व्यापक कृषि अशांति को जन्म देने वाले अंतर्निहित संरचनात्मक कारणों और कानूनी मापदंडों का विश्लेषण कीजिए:
oe: The zamindars systematically enhanced rents beyond legal limits and blocked tenants from acquiring occupancy rights under Act X of 1859
The permanent eradication of all local civil law courts by the crown, leaving peasants entirely free from any litigations
The mandatory implementation of the Ryotwari assessment framework across all interior delta sectors of Yusufshahi Pargana
More than one of the above / None of the above
oh: जमींदारों ने कानूनी सीमाओं से परे किराए में व्यवस्थित रूप से वृद्धि की और 1859 के अधिनियम X के तहत किरायेदारों को दखलकारी अधिकार प्राप्त करने से रोका
क्राउन द्वारा सभी स्थानीय नागरिक कानून अदालतों का स्थायी उन्मूलन, जिससे किसान किसी भी मुकदमेबाजी से पूरी तरह मुक्त हो गए
यूसुफशाही परगना के सभी आंतरिक डेल्टा क्षेत्रों में रैयतवाड़ी मूल्यांकन ढांचे का अनिवार्य कार्यान्वयन
उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक / उपर्युक्त में से कोई नहीं
e:
Pabna Agrarian Unrest (1873-1885) Eastern Bengal ke Yusufshahi Pargana (now Bangladesh) mein zamindari extortion aur tenure exploitation ke against emerge hua tha.

• Option 1 is Correct because zamindars ne illegal cesses (Abwabs) collect kiye, measurement standard change karke rent bar-bar hike kiya, aur Rent Act X of 1859 ke under milne wale 12-year continuous occupancy rights (dakhalkari) ko prevent karne ke liye peasants ko forcibly evict aur costly litigation mein trap kiya.
• Option 2 and 3 are Incorrect because courts exist karti thin jahan zamindars fabricated suits file karte the, aur Eastern Bengal Permanent Settlement (Zamindari) belt tha na ki Ryotwari.

Examiner trap: Act X of 1859 gave occupancy rights to tenants holding land for 12 continuous years; zamindars manipulated records to prevent tenants from completing 12 years.

qe: Consider the following statements regarding the forms of struggle and institutional support networks assembled during the Pabna Agrarian Uprisings:
qh: पाबना कृषि विद्रोह के दौरान आयोजित संघर्ष के रूपों और संस्थागत सहायता नेटवर्कों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
se: The peasants of Yusufshahi Pargana organized a highly structured agrarian league to collectively resist the illegal demands of the landlords.
The primary modus operandi of the league was marked by extreme, bloody physical violence and the wholesale burning of native municipal treasuries.
Young Indian intellectuals and associations, including Bankim Chandra Chatterjee, R.C. Dutt, and the Indian Association under Surendranath Banerjea, supported the peasants' cause.
sh: यूसुफशाही परगने के किसानों ने जमींदारों की अवैध मांगों का सामूहिक रूप से विरोध करने के लिए एक अत्यधिक संरचित कृषि लीग का गठन किया।
लीग की प्राथमिक कार्यप्रणाली अत्यधिक हिंसक थी, जिसमें स्थानीय सरकारी खजानों को पूरी तरह से जला दिया गया था।
बंकिम चंद्र चटर्जी, आर.सी. दत्त, और सुरेंद्रनाथ बनर्जी के नेतृत्व में इंडियन एसोसिएशन सहित युवा भारतीय बुद्धिजीवियों और संघों ने किसानों के मुद्दे का समर्थन किया।
oe: More than one of the above / None of the above
oh: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक / उपर्युक्त में से कोई नहीं
e:
Pabna Movement (1873) Indian peasant history mein legalistic aur constitutional resistance ka quintessential model mana jata hai.

• Statement 1 is Correct because May 1873 mein Yusufshahi Pargana ke peasants ne ek organized 'Agrarian League' banayi jo union funds collect karti thi aur zamindars ke khilaf collective legal battles fight karti thi.
• Statement 2 is Incorrect because Pabna struggle remarkable taur par peaceful aur non-violent tha; isme murder ya loot-pat nahi thi, balki court litigations aur rent refusal ko weapon banaya gaya tha.
• Statement 3 is Correct because urban intelligentsia—jaise Bankim Chandra Chatterjee, Anandamohan Bose, Dwarkanath Ganguly, Romesh Chandra Dutt aur Surendranath Banerjea ki Indian Association—ne ryots ke rights ko campaign kiya.

Examiner trap: Pabna ryots declared that they wanted to be the 'Ryots of Her Majesty the Queen of England and of Her only'—appealing to the law rather than defying state authority.

qe: What final macro-legislative act was passed by the colonial government in 1885 to partially resolve the worst features of zamindari oppression in Bengal?
qh: बंगाल में जमींदारी उत्पीड़न की सबसे खराब विशेषताओं को आंशिक रूप से हल करने के लिए 1885 में औपनिवेशिक सरकार द्वारा कौन सा अंतिम विधायी अधिनियम पारित किया गया था?
oe: The Deccan Agriculturists Relief Act, which instituted separate courts for peasant debtors
The General Service Enlistment Act, which restricted the land rights of traditional taluqdars
The Bengal Tenancy Act, which was enacted following promises to protect tenants after lingering discontent
More than one of the above / None of the above
oh: दक्कन कृषक राहत अधिनियम, जिसने किसान देनदारों के लिए अलग अदालतें स्थापित कीं
सामान्य सेवा भर्ती अधिनियम, जिसने पारंपरिक तालुकदारों के भूमि अधिकारों को प्रतिबंधित कर दिया
बंगाल किरायेदारी अधिनियम (Bengal Tenancy Act), जो लगातार असंतोष के बाद किरायेदारों की रक्षा के वादों के बाद अधिनियमित किया गया था
उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक / उपर्युक्त में से कोई नहीं
e:
Pabna agitation aur continuous peasant discontent ke direct outcome ke roop mein colonial government ne tenurial laws ko overhaul kiya.

• Option 3 is Correct because lengthy debates aur Indian Association ke sustained advocacy ke baad government ne **Bengal Tenancy Act of 1885** pass kiya, jisne occupancy raiyats ko fixed tenancy rights diye aur arbitrary evictions par substantial restrictions lagaye.
• Option 1, 2 and 4 are Incorrect because Deccan Agriculturists Relief Act 1879 mein Maharashtra riots ke baad pass hua tha, aur General Service Enlistment Act 1856 ka military sepoys se related act tha.

Examiner trap: 1885 witnessed two historic milestones: the birth of the Indian National Congress and the passage of the Bengal Tenancy Act.

qe: Consider the following statements analyzing the triple economic triggers that precipitated the severe Deccan Riots within western India:
qh: पश्चिमी भारत के भीतर गंभीर दक्कन दंगों (Deccan Riots) को जन्म देने वाले तीन आर्थिक कारणों का विश्लेषण करने वाले निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
